description: 강원도_지진계측기 현황 [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 강원특별자치도. 강원특별자치도 내 지진계측기의 설치 및 운영 현황에 관한 정보입니다. 데이터에는 시군구명, 관측소명, 경도(WGS84 좌표), 위도(WGS84 좌표), 관측기관, 운영기관, 관측개시연도, 관측소 유형, 운영상태, 소재지 지번주소, 특이사항, 관측장비, 관측내용 등의 정보가 포함되어 있습니다. 이를 통해... Coverage: 강원특별자치도. The portal files it under the publisher 강원특별자치도. Its tags are 지진관측, 관측소, 관측기, 지진, 계측기. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
